answer_1.quote: Neural dialogue systems are trained over a large dialogue corpus and used to predict responses given a context. There are two lines of methods. Retrievebased methods and generation based methods rely on matching scores and perplexity scores, respectively.
answer_1.outputs: selected dialogue responses from candidate options
